'''[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Williwalt''' was a notable microbiologist who, in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], worked with [[Nom Anor|Dassid Cree'Ar]] to develop a strain of bacteria that could eat through [[Duro/Legends|Duro's]] toxic sludge.
